notes.title: Antiprism v1.04
notes.content:
The 1.04 version of the game should be live now. The main additions are the 2 new missions in the final chapter ("Service corridors" and "The guard"), and the new loading system. The missions complete the chapter and the single player campaign. The new loading system reduces the waiting time when launching the first mission after starting the game.

Changes since last version:
- added 2 more missions to chapter 6
- improved game loading time
- music tracks change between missions instead of chapters
- added low pass sound filter when player ships are near death
- updated Survivor mode enemy configurations
- updated UFO movement sound

notes.title: Update notes for v1.03
notes.content:
New fixes and improvements:
- fixed problem with Survivor mode wave 12
- added more enemies to Survivor mode
- increased Survivor mode credits award
- added 750 credits at Survivor mode start
- fixed player death reporting (related to "Getting into it" and "Practice makes perfect" achievements)
- fixed Selysian scouts level 5 & 6 battery directions
- lowered Selysian scouts health points
- C'szuut now teleports before running out of health points (chapter 1 mission 6 "Meeting C'szuut")
- added visual distinctions for Selysian scouts level 5 & 6 and weak Kheelee warriors

notes.title: Antiprism Demo now available!
notes.content:
Due to popular demand, we released a Demo build of Antiprism containing the first chapter of the story mode.

If you were wondering whether Antiprism is your kind of game, you can now try it for free an decide!

notes.title: Update notes for v1.02
notes.content:
New bugfixes and polishes:
- added a lot of missing environment hitboxes
- fixed shooting direction of chapter 6 (Vel Selysian guard) enemies (whoops)
- tweaked Survivor mode enemy configuration

notes.title: Update notes for v1.01
notes.content:
Some small bugfixes and polishes:
- fixed chapter 1 mission 6 not giving shotgun as a reward (you have to do the mission again to get it)
- hyperjump animation when switching zones
- chapter 3 & 6 music updates
- improved survivor mode rewards
- added some missing hitboxes for environment objects

notes.title: Antiprism just got released with a 15% launch discount!
notes.content:
We're happy and proud to announce that Antiprism has finally reached 1.0 and is now available on Steam! Grab your copy now with a 15% discount for the launch week!

This is a huge milestone for us, but we still have plans for Antiprism's future. We'll be working on localization & looking out for any bugs that we missed or potential game balance improvements that could be made. 

If you have any questions, feedback or just want to hang out with us and other players, feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/PcaUvQkUw9]join our Discord[/url].

Thanks for following our journey! We hope you have fun playing Antiprism!

notes.title: Antiprism Beta progress update
notes.content:
Hey, it's been a little over two weeks since the first round of closed beta started on our Discord. 

We're happy to say that we received a ton of useful feedback and even happier to say that the most common forms of feedback were among the lines of "Wow, this is really fun!"

Here's a short list of fixes and improvements that we implemented thanks to our beta testers, in no particular order:

[h3]Quality of life improvements:[/h3]
[*] Show total and remaining credits in item upgrade UI
[*] Use different sound effects for shield loss and shield regen
[*] Reveal locked missions in map overview
[*] Better UI for showing that a mission has been completed
[/list]
[h3]Performance and bug fixes:[/h3]
[*] Fixed framerate drop in large battles (caused by trying to play 1000 sounds at once...)
[*] Replaced placeholder font in mission description UI
[*] Survivor mode: progress was not reset properly after dying
[*] Survivor mode: unable to purchase item upgrade even though player has enough credits
[/list]

We also received a lot of cool feature suggestions! We'll do our best to implement them over the next 1-2 months.

In the meantime, we're planning to run another round of beta in mid-April with a new build that contains more chapters of the campaign, more weapons and more enemy types, so stay tuned and [url=https://discord.gg/PcaUvQkUw9]join our Discord[/url] if you want to participate!
